illustrative_field_profile: 6 pressure-level quantities *14 levels + 9 surface fields; not a scientifically admitted production subset
limitations: Range selects complete global messages; regional crop does not proportionally reduce network bytes
Compressed size is observed for this cycle only, not a bandwidth guarantee
Memory excludes staging, scratch, geometry, particles, caches, output and metadata
Static terrain is only present at +0; its timestamp is not a new dynamic observation
15-minute output is 192 intervals, not 192 independent weather inputs; 3-hour forcing brackets 12 output intervals
Published +48 forecast run does not cover wall-clock now+48 if cycle age >0; use larger lead plus preparation support
No operational latency SLA measured; HTTP Last-Modified is an observation, not guaranteed publication time
